findings.title: Protected DACL with Everyone full access is accepted
findings.evidence: r09-focused-tests.raw.txt; TestIndependentQualificationProtectedWorldWritableDirectoryRejected FAIL; Go native exit 1; reconfirmed r20.go.stdout.raw with separate native output
findings.detail: Own fresh temp directory received PrivateDirectory then icacls /grant *S-1-1-0:(OI)(CI)F. Native icacls succeeded and displayed Everyone and current user full access. PersistQualificationRejection returned nil and created receipt. D:P plus current SID presence is insufficient privacy. The reader uses the same predicate.
findings.fix: Enumerate native DACL ACEs and reject untrusted write/delete/WRITE_DAC/WRITE_OWNER grants; validate actual owner and allow only explicitly intended trusted principals. Validate source-file ACL/reparse/file identities as well as directories, retain native no-delete/rename identity handles across checking/opening/flushing/reading rather than repeated pathname checks. Reject unsafe inputs without creating a receipt; do not repair an externally permissive directory to make the check pass.
findings.limits: Independent fixture shows privacy predicate failure, not a production exploit or current user data mutation. Same-SID independent agent is not protected holdout.

findings.title: Private consumer does not bind confirmed MODEL request and receipt to sealed proof
findings.evidence: r15-private-tamper-tests.raw.txt; TestIndependentQualificationPrivateConsumerModelReceiptTamper FAIL; Go native exit 1; reconfirmed r20.go.stdout.raw with separate native output
findings.detail: After a real owned loopback first-gate closure, baseline validatedQualificationFailureTx succeeds. In a rolled-back owned fixture transaction, disable resource_effects append-only triggers and change exactly one CONFIRMED row receipt.receipt_id to sha256:forged-independent. Sealed proof, marker and observation remain unchanged; the actual private consumer still returns a closure. It currently checks only CONFIRMED plus nonnil receipt. This is proof validation of corrupted source data, not a claim production exposes arbitrary SQL.
findings.fix: At initial verification bind the exact MODEL effect project/run/epoch/key, sequence/history and canonical request body/request_hash, route/capability/credential revision, canonical receipt and receipt_id/provider_response_hash to the exact acknowledged frame2 and durable host MODEL fact/response bytes. Persist those immutable digests in sealed proof and marker-bound plan. Recompute them from stored resource_effects and original durable fact at the private consumer, and reject changed request, receipt, key/subject/epoch/route/history. Define canonical Hash(Bytes-decoded Object) versus raw Digest explicitly: frame payload/raw source retain raw digests, stored canonical objects use one canonical algorithm; never hash only state or receipt existence. Add independent request and receipt tamper controls while proof/marker stay fixed.
findings.limits: Only receipt_id corruption was independently executed here; request replacement is a static omission and required companion test.
